title: Recording: Beware My Love by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings continued work on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Beware My Love’ on 10 February 1976.

This was primarily an overdub session for Jimmy McCulloch to add lead guitar. The session lasted from 2.30-8pm.
